derived_from: Speedtest Analyzer device_validation_catalog.json (catalog_version 2026-08-20), reduced to the model names WAN identity needs. SD-WAN Analyzer keeps its own copy; there is no runtime dependency on Speedtest Analyzer.
maintenance: controllers: host routers that can pair with captive modems. A cellular WAN owned by one of these is labelled '<MODEL> Internal'. Same set as the keys of single_captive_combinations in the Speedtest Analyzer catalog.
standalone_devices: host routers whose own modem carries no ' Internal' suffix. Used only to recognise the host model family.
captive_modems: attachable modem models. Matched case-insensitively against info.remote.product_name; the longest match wins.
Model matching is token based: E3000 matches E3000-5GB, but R98 does not match R980.
Restart or rebuild the application after editing so the catalog is reloaded.
